scope: Design and CPU data construction only; no model inference, phase-I extraction, training, job submission, candidate ranking or external benchmark evaluation.

training.phase_I: frozen inference-mode representation; never random fallback
training.phase_II: independent initialization using fixed seed, unchanged V1 architecture
training.software: Preserve original TF2.20.0/Keras3.14.1 environment captured in architecture audit; exact environment must be checked before any later approved execution.

augmentation.cache: g(forward nucleotide sequence) and g(RC nucleotide sequence) independently; never reverse 4560-dimensional embedding

inference.seed_aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of all3 seeds in fixed seed order
inference.ref_alt_identity: complement independently, do not exchange REF and ALT

checkpoint.data: configuration-native labels and controls on global chr7 checkpoint-role IDs only

validation_roles.unit: global full2001bp overlap components unioned by encoded-sequence/RC identity
validation_roles.matching_pair_roles: identical by exact stratum; no role-specific outcomes used

selection.panel: same frozen common challenge panel for all configurations, each model separately
selection.margin_status: pragmatic proposed pretraining tolerances for investigator approval, not data/outcome optimized

bootstrap.unit: global genomic overlap/encoded-sequence component, conditional on fixed matching design; not matching links between distant loci
bootstrap.paired: same resampled component IDs and multiplicities across model predictions
bootstrap.resample: sample represented component IDs with replacement, same number of components as observed; carry all component rows
bootstrap.invalid: one-class draw or undefined metric; no imputation

selection.superiority: lower95(delta_AP)>0 AND point(delta_AP)>=0.02 AND lower95(delta_AUROC)>=-0.02 AND upper95(delta_Brier)<=0.02
selection.equivalence: entire90CI for each of delta_AP, delta_AUROC, delta_Brier lies inside[-0.02,0.02]
selection.adequacy: construction gates PASS; all3 seeds complete; real-network invariance PASS; lower95(AUROC)>0.5; lower95(AP minus replicate prevalence)>0; lower95(BrierSkill)>0
selection.reliability: ten fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; descriptive, no fitted recalibration
selection.stratification: GC quintiles, ATAC-rank quintiles, repeat quintiles using TRAIN positive cutpoints only; lobe support, chromosome, ambiguous-base status; cells<100 observations descriptive only
selection.retention: Retain whole V2-C only if BOTH model contexts adequate and C noninferior to B. Superior/equivalent/noninferior are distinct labels. Otherwise stop; no automatic mixed configuration or fallback to known-defective A/B.

threshold.data: only common chr7-calibration negative-control distribution after retained model and ensemble freeze
threshold.formula: k=floor(0.05*n); d=descending negative scores; t=nextafter(d[k] in zero-based indexing,+infinity)

candidate_plan.historical_V1_P95: historical descriptive comparator only, not calibrated allele-effect FDR

external_firewall.permitted_pretraining_access: opaque file hashing only; no parsed benchmark outcomes/labels
external_firewall.open_once_only_after: retained configuration, checkpoints, all3seeds, inference, threshold and selection record frozen; no redesign after external outcome

stop_conditions: matching balance or support gates fail
later seed instability or real-network invariance failure
conditional_not_launched: C-specific control rematching to restore same-lobe covariate/source balance, explicitly estimating label-plus-induced-rematching contrast
B common-support restriction or revised ratio/algorithm, only after investigator accepts changed estimand/design
new model family only after corrected internal design remains inadequate
implementation_note: This is an immutable proposal/data-construction snapshot, not a training-ready approval. No model-performance outcome was generated or used.
